technical.summary: Strong trend structure with price above all key moving averages and new highs, but extreme overbought conditions across RSI/Stoch with negative volume divergence (CMF, OBV, AD) create elevated pullback risk; suitable for swing entry only with tight stops or on momentum confirmation.

fundamental.summary: OMC shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 26 days create near-term uncertainty.

sentiment.summary: No congressional signal; market in fear (40 VIX equivalent) with bearish bias (38.3%) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and stale congressional trades (395+ days old) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (299.84) dominates; CPI event just occurred; normal yield curve provides limited support; 26-day earnings window adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong trend structure with price above all major moving averages, supertrend bullish, Ichimoku above cloud, and new 20-day highs provide solid technical foundation for continuation.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought RSI conditions (9 and 14 period), negative volume divergence across CMF/OBV/AD, low volume ratio (0.96), zero fundamental support, earnings risk in 26 days, and crisis-level VIX (299.84) create elevated pullback risk with no institutional conviction.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure remains bullish with price above all major moving averages and supertrend confirmation, but extreme overbought RSI conditions (9 and 14 period) combined with negative volume divergence (CMF, OBV, AD) signal distribution pressure rather than accumulation.
decision.primary_risk: Crisis-level VIX (299.84) in unfavourable macro environment combined with 26-day earnings window and zero fundamental/institutional support creates asymmetric downside risk with no conviction anchor.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical and risk agents aligned on overbought/macro concerns; fundamental and sentiment agents reinforce weakness; debate correctly identifies bear case as stronger.
decision.portfolio_note: Existing OMC position plus 8 open Communication Services positions (3.3% sector concentration) argue against new entry; portfolio drawdown at 0% allows full sizing but concentration risk and earnings proximity warrant avoidance.
